lines: A young man watched the stars set... and found the One who never sets.
When the night covered him, he saw a star. He said: This is my lord. But when it set, he said: I like not those that disappear.
The moon rose... and set. The sun rose... and set too.
And Prophet Ibrahim, alayhis salaam, said: Indeed, I have turned my face toward He who created the heavens and the earth.
Everything you lean on will set one day. Lean on the One who never does.
The full movie of Prophet Ibrahim, alayhis salaam, comes this Saturday. Follow so you don't miss it.
